_comment: combat_walkthrough's natural new shape is the part-1 + part-2 tutorial arc. Part 1 -- the classless spar vs the inert training dummies (proves combat opens/renders with NO class kit). Sleep -> Warrior L1. Part 2 -- the mandatory floodplains proximity ambush (goblin_encounter_1) fought with the warrior kit + Relc fielded as an ally (ally_requires{met_relc} banked in part 1), where the combat-mechanics teeth live: roster-POSITIVE (relc.side==player), 4-slot hotbar, ap 4, Attack targeting opens and CANCELS spending nothing (ap stays 4), and the combat HP/MP stats overlay projects on-screen (assert_world_labels_in_view). Victory banks won_combat + sign_defended and the gate opens onto the street. (Stale-comment fix, GH#373 rider: this used to claim goblin_encounter_1 respawns and is therefore never entity_removed. It carries no `respawns` key and no `persistent` key, so combat_banking's own branch DOES remove it on a win -- the claim was false in both halves. No pin changes; this script never asserted removed_entities.) Seed 9 (live). Cells reuse mage_unlock_loop's proven phase A/B.
